title: Eval Result
description: Schema for evaluation results of the agent pack

eval_id.description: Unique identifier for this evaluation run

pack_version.description: Version of the agent pack being evaluated

runner.description: Name or identifier of the entity running the eval

model_name.description: Name of the model used for the evaluation

run_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the eval was run

prompt_hash.description: Hash of the prompt used for reproducibility

skill_hash.description: Hash of the skill definitions used

agent_config_hash.description: Hash of the agent configuration used

hard_fail.description: Whether any hard fail conditions were triggered

missing_fields.description: List of required fields that were missing from the output

notes.description: Additional notes about the eval run

variance_note.description: Notes on variance between expected and actual output

detailed_results.description: Detailed results for each test case
